restore_fields.content_zh:
不要只按现在人数排座位

团队如果还会扩充，工位、电位、网络点和储物要留一点余量。否则很快又要改。

会议室要看真实使用频率

不是每家公司都需要很多大会议室。小讨论区、电话间和安静工作位有时更实用。

大楼规则会影响工期

搬运时间、电梯预约、消防要求和噪音限制要提前确认，避免材料到了却不能进场。

准备进入现场范围讨论时，可先查看我们的办公室装修与商业空间规划服务，并在申请报价前整理大楼要求。
restore_fields.content_en:
Do not plan seats only for today

If the team may grow, leave allowance for workstations, sockets, network points, and storage.

Match meeting rooms to real usage

Not every office needs many large rooms. Small discussion areas, call rooms, and quiet seats may be more useful.

Building rules affect schedule

Delivery hours, lift booking, fire-safety requirements, and noisy-work limits should be confirmed before materials arrive.

When planning a site-specific scope, review our office renovation and commercial fit-out service and prepare the building requirements before requesting a quotation.
